title: What I Love About Sex
author: Stephanie Ganowski
description: What I Love About Sex is the podcast for successful men who overthink sex. If you're confident everywhere else but your sex life, this show is especially for you. Hosted by clinical sexologist and men's sex coach Stephanie Ganowski, each episode gives you practical, judgment-free tools to get out of your head, feel confident with her, and ask for what you want. Topics include: how to last longer in bed, premature ejaculation, erectile dysfunction and staying hard, delayed ejaculation, performance anxiety, overthinking during sex, low sex drive and mismatched desire in marriage, how to initiate sex, how to talk to your wife or girlfriend about sex, porn and masturbation, and sexual confidence for men.
